source.original_question:
Consider the sector below. 

Calculate the perimeter of the sector. Round your answer to two decimal places.

audit.source_question:
Consider the sector below. 

Calculate the perimeter of the sector. Round your answer to two decimal places.

adaptation.reason: The source image shows a major sector but omits its angle; radius alone cannot determine the perimeter. Explicitly set the missing reflex angle to 344° and independently recomputed the perimeter. Decorative page borders and filled angle shading are removed; one bound reflex angle arc is drawn.

audit.independent_solution: For radius 32.2m and reflex angle 344°, the perimeter is 2r+(344/360)·2πr=64.4+(344/360)·64.4π≈257.7268m, rounding to 257.73m.
audit.geometry_notes: Coordinates were analytically constructed from the stated conditions. Computed lengths freeze a faithful shape without exposing the answer as a label. Source connections, point order, mathematical labels and relation groups were compared visually; any necessary condition or representation changes are described in adaptation.reason. Display-only coordinates do not add question conditions.

source_visual_review.method: Viewed original image at readable scale before native geometric construction

redraw_visual_review.note: Compared the reflex sector boundary and radius. The missing reflex angle is explicitly adapted to 344 degrees and is not claimed as a source value. Kept one bound angle arc and removed the screenshot frame.
